simple.meaning: צֶאֶל (tseʼel) is a Hebrew word meaning “the lotus tree.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צֶאֶל (H6628) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 40:21, with occurrences in Job.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צֶאֶל (H6628) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צֶאֶל (H6628) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צֶאֶל (tseʼel) / H6628 is traced through Job 40:21, Job 40:22 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
